Reach

Everywhere you can get to from one spot in NYC, on foot or by subway. Click the map to check a destination; drag the pin to move your start.

Getting around
45 min

    How times are estimated

    Subway schedules come from the MTA’s published timetable (fall 2026). Waiting time is half the usual gap between trains for the period you pick, plus a minute to reach the platform. Walking is 4.8 km/h with a 25% allowance for street grids, and walks don’t cross rivers. Buses, ferries, PATH and LIRR aren’t included, and there are no live delays or weekend service changes.
